# FelixFangX

> Public agent tools: a browser game for reviewing an agent run, taste checks for MapLibre and ECharts, and a mind-map to Markdown converter. Commit dates are the latest commit on the default branch.

Snapshot 2026-11-23 from the public GitHub API. A check line is included only when a completed push run is named CI or check.

## Repos

- [ledring](https://github.com/FelixFangX/ledring): Review AI builders like a game: watch the branch tree, catch instruction drift. Try: https://play.ledring.dev/play/ · npm install -g ledring@beta. Status: latest commit 2026-11-10; CI success 2026-11-10.
- [maptaste](https://github.com/FelixFangX/maptaste): Stop agents shipping rainbow MapLibre choropleths. Try: npx maptaste check style.json --taste ink-paper. Status: latest commit 2026-11-10; check success 2026-11-10.
- [dashtaste](https://github.com/FelixFangX/dashtaste): Stop agents shipping rainbow ECharts dashboards. Try: npx dashtaste check dashboard.json --taste saas-dense. Status: latest commit 2026-11-10; CI success 2026-11-10.
- [lakeboard-converter](https://github.com/FelixFangX/lakeboard-converter): Mind maps your agents can actually read — Lakeboard/XMind → Markdown. Try: https://convert.ledring.dev · npx -y lakeboard-converter mcp. Status: latest commit 2026-11-10; CI success 2026-11-10.
- [dev-work-grok-bot-skill](https://github.com/FelixFangX/dev-work-grok-bot-skill): Turn a Grok Bot into a safe work assistant for your product. Try: skills/dev-work-bot-setup/SKILL.md. Status: latest commit 2026-11-10; CI success 2026-11-10; rule strings 42/42 (file check, not a model test).
- [n8n-workflow-collection](https://github.com/FelixFangX/n8n-workflow-collection): Import-ready n8n: Lark→Bitable PRDs + social metrics. Prefer lark-cli + Grok Bot for new work. Try: README · npm run preflight. Status: latest commit 2026-11-10; CI success 2026-11-10.
- [ledring.dev](https://github.com/FelixFangX/ledring.dev): ledring.dev — status lights for AI agents + Play. Try: https://ledring.dev. Status: latest commit 2026-11-03; CI no data.
